full_description: Associate Research Scientist – Evidence Generation (Primary Data Collection) Are you looking to work with a dynamic team of industry leading professionals in the HEOR space? Is your passion leading research studies that improve healthcare outcomes worldwide? Our Evidence Generation team is hiring an Associate Research Scientist to join our team of research professionals conducting primary data collection studies in the pharmaceutical and biotech space; contributing to study execution, problem solving, and supporting both qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis efforts. About You: You have an interest in health economics and outcomes research and a basic understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and medical affairs, with a willingness to learn how to identify client needs and considerations. You have experience supporting activities that contribute to collecting data from multiple types of stakeholders in the healthcare ecosystem: patients, caregivers, providers, payers and policy makers. You have experience conducting literature reviews, scientific writing, supporting data synthesis and interpretation, and deliverable creation. You have experience in qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis tasks, including supporting the development of data collection materials (e.g., surveys, interview discussion guides), familiarity with qualitative analysis software (e.g., NVivo, Dedoose) and quantitative programs (e.g., Excel, R, SAS, or Stata), and experience with qualitative and quantitative data interpretation and visualization. You assist with the implementation of research plans and methodologies, working closely with team members to support study execution and project coordination. You have strong verbal and visual communication skills and can support the development of client-ready presentation materials (e.g., slide decks) to convey insights to internal and external stakeholders. About The Role: As an Associate Research Scientist on the Evidence Generation team, you will contribute to multiple projects, working with cross-functional teams across mixed-methods research approaches and a range of therapeutic areas. Study Execution : Support all aspects of execution of primary data collection research studies, including literature reviews; development of data collection instruments (e.g., surveys, interview guides); study protocols; data collection; data analysis and interpretation; and support dissemination activities. Deliverable Creation : Contribute to the development of project deliverables under the guidance of senior team members with methodological and subject matter expertise. Project Management : Assist with the delivery of project components by collaborating with team members to ensure high-quality outputs and help maintain project timelines for assigned tasks. Client Management : Support client engagement activities by drafting update slides for regular client meetings with guidance from senior team members, and documenting meeting notes, action items, and next steps. Business Development : Contribute to proposal and presentation development by drafting background sections, task descriptions, timelines, and references with guidance from senior team members. full_description: Research Scientist - Health Economic Modeling Remote, Canada or United States Join Our Dynamic HEOR Team as a Research Scientist! Are you a self-starter with a passion for projects involving innovative methods in health economics and evidence synthesis? Our Evidence Synthesis and Decision Modeling team is seeking a Research Scientist (Decision Modeling) to join our group of industry-leading professionals. You will collaborate with a highly specialized team of health economists, statisticians and researchers in methodologically innovative projects for our pharma and biotech clients. You will contribute to diverse projects including cost-effectiveness analyses and budget impact analyses to support HTA submissions and payer decisions, early economic analyses, treatment sequencing analyses, and generalised cost-effectiveness analyses incorporating novel elements of value. Why Join Us? Innovative Culture : Experience the fast-paced and dynamic environment of a start-up within a well-funded, established global organization. Passionate Team : Work with a team that has a real passion for Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) and prides itself on being visionary leaders in the field. Growth Opportunities : Be part of a growing, high performing team where you’ll have the opportunity to tackle complex methodological challenges. About You: Experienced Consultant: You have a background in HEOR, with a solid understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and medical affairs. HEOR Research Experience: You have experience performing targeted literature reviews to identify and summarize model inputs and methodologies used in previous health technology assessments. You can identify considerations relevant to the model development given available evidence and can work with senior leads to conceptualize the design of cost-effectiveness models and budget impact models. You have experience programming, parameterizing, and validating economic models. You can conduct analyses, interpret the findings, and communicate the results. Deliverable Creation: You contribute to the development of client-ready study deliverables such as model protocols, economic models, slide decks, technical reports, and peer-reviewed publications under the guidance of senior team members. You pay attention to detail and perform quality checks of your own work and that of others. Technical Proficiency : You demonstrate proficiency in programming economic models in Microsoft Excel. You have strong skills in preparing written documentation and presenting results using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint. Effective Communicator : You can interpret and communicate study results to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Project and Time Management : You assist with the delivery of components of projects by collaborating with other team members to ensure high quality outputs. You ensure timely delivery of project components by flagging changes to estimates of required hours. Client Management: You contribute to client management by preparing slides for client meetings under guidance from senior team members, drafting meeting minutes and summarizing action items. You communicate with clients on calls and sometimes support senior team members in responding to client emails.
